subject: QBR shiproom: consolidated risks & launch decisions
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QBR shiproom: consolidated risks & launch decisions

Team —

As we prep the QBR shiproom next week I need a single consolidated risk snapshot and the set of preferred launch decisions by end of day Monday. Specifically: 
- Current hard blockers that could shift the ship window (code, infra, third-party integrations)
- Estimated exposure per blocker (latency, cost, customer impact)
- Mitigation chosen (rollback, feature gate, reduced config surface) and owner
- Any ask for SLA exceptions, credits, or postponed features for the initial launch

Please attach any short artifacts (heatmap, perf profiles, customer impact notes). I started a drive folder and added a product_roadmap_v3.pdf — use that as the canonical timeline. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-qbr-shiproom

We need this in a form I can present to execs — concise bullets and one-slide risk heatmap.

Thanks,
Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: product_roadmap_v3.pdf (pdf)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: rohan.mehta@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-25T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR shiproom: consolidated risks & launch decisions

Rohan —

Thanks, forwarding our current state below. High level: UI and onboarding flows are green for the core paths; the experimental multi-tenant admin panel is not ready for GA and we recommend gating it.

Key items:
- Feature: Admin multi-tenant panel — Blocker: auth/session token refresh race on edge (occurs at scale). Exposure: high (customer visibility, security). Mitigation: gate behind feature flag + gradual rollout; owner: lauren_bishop.
- Feature: Self-serve billing page — Blocker: invoice generation edge cases w/ certain VAT profiles. Exposure: medium. Mitigation: disable VAT auto-apply for initial launch; owner: stephanie_nguyen.
- Timeline change: if we gate admin panel, launch date remains intact; if we keep it, add 2-week stabilization window.

Attached a short spreadsheet with UI test failure categories.

-Lauren
Lauren Bishop
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

Attachment: ui-stability-report.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-26T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR shiproom: consolidated risks & launch decisions

Rohan —

Infra update (short): we observed a regression in model cold-start latency after the last kernel swap on our internal perf run. Impact: request 95p increased ~80ms for large-context prompts, which bumps latency above the SLO for a subset of enterprise routes.

Options I recommend:
1) Fast mitigation (preferred): route enterprise traffic to the previous kernel variant for 72 hours while we validate fixes; cost: small increase in vCPU utilization; rollout: immediate.
2) Longer mitigation: apply additional quantization profile and re-run benchmarks — timeline +5 business days, risk: accuracy delta at tail cases.

Action needed: Executive sign-off to do a temporary kernel rollback for the affected Dedicated pools. If approved we will open INFR-4821 and tag canary groups.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment: perf-profiles-0426.csv (csv)

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai; Jennifer Park <jennifer.park@acmecloud.com>, procurement@acmecloud.com
Date: 2027-04-27T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidated shiproom brief + proposed decisions (for exec review)

Team / Jen —

Thanks for the fast turnarounds. Below is the consolidated brief I will take to shiproom and the QBR exec slot. Please confirm by EOD Tuesday if you disagree with any decision.

Executive summary (concise):
- Scope: GA launch will include core inference APIs + managed embeddings and excludes the multi-tenant admin panel. Billing UI will be simplified for non-EU VAT flows; full VAT handling deferred to post-GA.
- Major risk: model kernel regression impacting 95p latency for enterprise routes. Proposed mitigation: temporary kernel rollback for affected Dedicated pools (Markus to own). Requires exec approval due to minor cost impact.
- Customer impact: Acme Cloud integration window unaffected if rollback is applied as a behind-the-scenes kernel swap; no deploy coordination needed on their side.
- Ask: Vivek — approve temporary kernel rollback + authorize up to 2 weeks of cost delta for canary routing. Also approve gating of admin panel for GA.

Planned artifacts attached: product_roadmap_v3.pdf, ui-stability-report.xlsx, perf-profiles-0426.csv

Open items and owners:
- Confirm kernel rollback scheduling and canary group definitions (Markus)
- Final signoff on feature gating (Lauren)
- Customer comms: draft email to Acme explaining scope and timeline (Stephanie)

Link to presentation slide (one slide risk heatmap): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-qbr-shiproom
Jira references: INFR-4821 (kernel rollback), INFR-4822 (billing VAT deferral)

If no objections I will present this at the shiproom and ask for formal exec approval during the QBR slot.

-Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: rohan.mehta@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, jennifer.park@acmecloud.com
Date: 2027-04-28T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated shiproom brief + proposed decisions (for exec review)

Rohan —

I reviewed the brief. Approve the following, on condition that we track impact and revert within the 72-hour window if we see accuracy regressions:
- Approve temporary kernel rollback for affected Dedicated pools (Markus implement with canary plan).
- Approve gating of admin panel for GA.
- Approve up to 2 weeks of incremental cost for canary routing, but inform finance for credit/forecasting.

Operational asks before the QBR:
1) Mark the exec slide with explicit cost delta estimate and owner for monitoring (Markus).
2) Stephanie — draft the customer-facing note to Acme and share before EOD Wednesday.
3) Rohan — ensure the QBR slide deck includes decision timeline and go/no-go triggers.

I'll present these decisions in the QBR and be prepared to answer questions on rollback criteria. Good work synthesizing.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
CTO, Redwood Inference
